يستثنون (form X)
# يَسْتَثْنُونَ (yastaṯnūna) /jas.taθ.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# يُسْتَثْنَوْنَ (yustaṯnawna) /jus.taθ.naw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
